{"metadata":{"description":"An IM gateway for the DeepSeek Harness: bridge messengers into harness agent sessions and control them with slash commands.","id":"gh:1334093787","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-im-gateway","slug":"jelech/dsh-im-gateway","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"An IM gateway for the DeepSeek Harness: bridge messengers into harness agent sessions and control th"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"em with slash commands."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-im-gateway"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"An IM gateway for the DeepSeek Harness: bridge messengers into harness agent sessions and control th"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"em with slash commands."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"- **WeChat** via Tencent's official **iLink Bot** transport (the same one OpenClaw's `@tencent-weixi"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"n/openclaw-weixin` uses) — QR login, long-poll, no public endpoint/ngrok required.
- **Slash command"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"s** modeled on Hermes Agent's messaging interface: `/new`, `/sessions`, `/status`, `/model`, …
- **O"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ne agent session per peer**: every IM contact gets its own harness agent (same model, tools, workspa"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ce), so conversations have memory and stay isolated."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Two halves, per the harness convention:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Host** (`index.js`, `lib/`): the gateway. Runs once per process because the channel token and pe"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"er→session map must be shared, not per-session.
- **Client** (`client.js`): an optional browser "IM "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"网关" settings section (QR login, status, test). Discovered automatically via the package's `dsh.clien"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ction (QR login, status, test). | `/new"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"` (or `/reset`)     | Archive the current session and start a fresh one             |
| `/sessions` "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"             | List current + archived sessions for this peer                |
| `/status`          "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"      | Show connection, model, and current session                   |
| `/model [provider:model]`|"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" Show current model, or switch (`provider:model`) into a new session |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Roadmap: `/retry`, `/undo`, `/compress`, `/usage`, `/personality`, `/stop` (interrupt), and skill in"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"`/retry`, `/undo`, `/compress`, `/usage`, `/personality`, `/stop` (interrupt), and skill invocation."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"This is a Cordis plugin package that targets the harness host plane. It declares `dsh.bundle`, so th"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"e official `dsh plugin` command installs it *and* composes it automatically — no manual composition "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"icial `dsh plugin` command installs it *and* composes it automatically — no manual composition edit."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### From GitHub (before/without npm publish)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"`dsh plugin` forwards to `pnpm add`, and `github:user/repo` is a native pnpm spec. The package's `ds"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"h.bundle` declaration then joins it to the profile's bundle layers automatically (this package has n"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"o `prepare`/build script, so no `allowBuilds` step is needed)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### From the npm registry (after publishing)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### From a local checkout"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Restart the harness after installing (composition is read at boot). The gateway registers an `imGate"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"way` service and, if the profile provides `webServer`, exposes `/im-gateway/*` plus the settings sec"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"service and, if the profile provides `webServer`, exposes `/im-gateway/*` plus the settings section."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"For a manual install instead of `dsh plugin`, the equivalent is `pnpm add dsh-im-gateway` from the p"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"rofile directory plus merging the `insert` row in `cordis.patch.yml` (see `cordis.patch.yml` in this"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"directory plus merging the `insert` row in `cordis.patch.yml` (see `cordis.patch.yml` in this repo)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Login"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"1. Open **设置 → IM 网关 → 扫码登录微信** (browser), or call `gateway.login()` and scan the QR printed to the "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"host console.
2. Scan with WeChat and confirm. The token is held in memory for the process lifetime."},{"id":"p25s3","text":"
3. Message the bot. Text messages are answered by the harness agent; `/`-prefixed messages are comm"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"essage the bot. Text messages are answered by the harness agent; `/`-prefixed messages are commands."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Notes & limitations"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Text only** for now. Media (image/voice/file) requires the iLink CDN AES-128-ECB path; it's isol"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ated behind the channel interface and can be added without touching the gateway core.
- **iOS needs "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"WeChat ≈ 8.0.70**; Android may prompt for a WeChat update first (iLink requirement).
- The browser p"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"anel renders the login QR **locally on the host** (via the `qrcode` npm package, served as SVG from "},{"id":"p27s5","text":"`/im-gateway/qrcode`) — no third-party QR service and no external network round-trip for the login l"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"ink.
- The `/im-gateway/*` HTTP bridge registers raw routes on the harness web server; if your deplo"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"yment enforces HTTP auth above the route layer, add it in `lib/http.js`."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
